name: Powerful Throwing (Combat)
body:
Your thrown weapons are as strong as they are accurate.

Prerequisite: Str 13

Benefit: You can use your Strength modifier for both your attack and damage rolls with thrown weapons.

Special: Starting at 2nd level, a ranger with the thrown weapon combat style may select Powerful Throwing as a combat style feat.
